invariant: Technical build attempts, validation and archive evidence.
mustPreserve: No current aggregate should retain all build attempts or delivery history as command state.
technicalStateToSeparate: build attempts, worker leases, cursors, external archive attempt metadata
logicalPhysicalRule: Logical technical responsibility is separate from physical storage/owner. Existing native operational journals may remain where required for exact recovery; this inventory does not require conversion to KV/CAS or count them as business authority.
